118656.name: Chabad at Midtown Miami
118656.note: Chabad.org, 25 April 2018 ('Pop Artist Romero Britto's Newest Canvas? A Limited-Edition Kippah'): 'Chabad of Midtown was founded by Rabbi Shmuel and Chana Gopin in 2003'. therebbesimpact.com also gives 2003; its charity listing (GoFundMe) gives 2004 as the year established, probably the incorporation. Now at 221 NE 29th St.; COLlive (6 Nov 2026): their son Rabbi Mendel Gopin joined 'Chabad at Midtown, which his father founded and leads'.

6429432.name: Chabad of Amelia Island & Nassau County
6429432.note: COLlive, 2 Sept 2024: 'Rabbi Levi and Mindy Katz (née Zucker), along with their son Sholom, are establishing the first Chabad House on Amelia Island', appointed by Rabbi Yosef and Rivkie Kahanov (Northeast Florida). Chabad.org, 18 Sept 2025: a resident got involved 'a year ago' after seeing the 'brand new Chabad of Amelia Island and Nassau County' on Facebook; the storefront center's ribbon-cutting was in August 2025.

117596.name: Synagogue of Inverrary - Chabad
117596.note: Chabad.org, 23 June 2015 (Aishel House): the idea 'came to Rabbi Aron Lieberman, who has led our congregation since 1982' (caption: 'had led the congregation since 1982'). COLlive, 15 Nov 2018: the Inverrary community was 'Founded over 33 years ago and led by Shliach Rabbi Aron Lieberman', which agrees. 6700 NW 44th Street. therebbesimpact.com: 1993 (unsourced, wrong).

463071.name: Chabad Israeli Center
463071.note: Chabad.org, 20 Feb 2008 ('Israelis Find Spiritual Homes in America'): 'the new Chabad Israeli Center directed by Rabbi Naftali and Henya Hertzel opened in 2006'; a caption calls him 'co-director of the two-year-old Chabad Israeli Center in Boca Raton, Fla.' On West Palmetto Park Road (chabad.org, 15 June 2017).

2018455.name: Chabad of Palm Aire in West Pompano Beach
2018455.note: Chabad.org, 15 Oct 2014 ('Par for the Course: A Florida Sukkah Fitted on a Golf Cart'): Rabbi Lipa and his wife Benjaminson's Chabad of Palm Aire, in West Pompano Beach, 'where the couple has lived for the past two years' (so about 2012). When the center itself began is not stated; the chabad.org listing (2018455) is from about 2012-13.

2113715.name: Chabad of Dadeland & West Kendall
2113715.note: Chabad.org, 14 Dec 2014 ('Timing Is Everything'): Rabbi Getzy Rubashkin and his wife have directed Chabad of West Kendall & The Falls 'since last December' (Dec 2013). It does not say they founded it; the chabad.org listing (2113715) is from about 2013.

765096.name: United Jewish Generations
765096.note: Chabad.org, 8 Sept 2016 ('First-Time Florida Bike-a-Thon Champions Seniors'): 'The 12-year-old United Jewish Generations provides services such as a retiree club' (so about 2004); Rabbi Menachem Smith, director. One count-back only.

570754.name: Jewish Recovery Center
570754.note: Chabad.org, 11 June 2008 ('Helping Those in Recovery'): Rabbi Meir and his wife Kessler 'moved to South Florida three years ago' (2005); 'Soon after, they founded the city's Jewish Recovery Center'; its women's halfway house was 'established by the center two years ago' (2006). So 2005, or early 2006.

395367.name: Chabad Student Center
395367.note: Chabad.org, 5 Oct 2011 ('Students Receive Free Mezuzahs'): the Chabad Student Center at FAU (Rabbi Boruch Shmuel Liberow) gave out free mezuzahs 'the fourth year in a row', so it existed by fall 2008. When it began is not stated.

118571.name: Chabad Jewish Center
118571.note: Neighborhood Times (St. Petersburg Times; CrownHeights.info, 6 Jan 2008): 'Five years ago, when Rabbi Alter Korf and his wife, Chaya, agreed to leave family and friends in New York to open southern Pinellas County's first Orthodox Jewish center' (count back: 2003). 'Offering programs initially in their home, they rented space for holiday celebrations.' Chabad.org, 5 April 2011 ('Larry King Entertains Florida Crowd'): Dr. Richard Sorkin 'moved to the area about eight years ago, around the same time as Alter and Chaya Korf', which agrees (2003). Later at 533 4th Street North (land bought 2019, groundbreaking April 2023).

118290.name: Chabad of Golden Beach
118290.note: Miami Herald (COLlive, 15 Sept 2009): Rabbi Chay Amar's 'Live with Chay Amar' chats, given 'for the past five years at Chabad of Golden Beach, the small synagogue he founded 11 years ago' (so 1998), in the basement of the Ramada in Sunny Isles Beach. IRS: 'Me-yad Jewish Outreach Program Chabad Of Golden Beach Inc', exempt from Sept 1998, which agrees.

7368606.name: Chabad Oakland Park East
7368606.note: Its own About page: 'Rabbi Yitzchok and Nina Naparstek launched Chabad of Oakland Park East in the summer of 2026'; 'Since 2006, Rabbi Yitzchok and Nina have been actively building Jewish community throughout the Fort Lauderdale area' (a division of Chabad Lubavitch of Fort Lauderdale). Not the Mochkins' Chabad of Oakland Park (COLlive, 24 March 2026).

337117.name: Chabad of Walnut Creek
337117.note: COLlive, 17 Oct 2017: 'Chabad of Walnut Creek was founded in 2003 to service the religious and community needs of a small and burgeoning Jewish population on the border of Hollywood, Pembroke Pines and East Davie', under Rabbi Zalman and Shana Korf. Its corporation CHABAD OF WALNUT CREEK, INC. (Sunbiz N05000010609) was filed in 2005, which agrees. 7561 Sheridan Street.

118605.name: Chabad of North West Dade /Miami Lakes & ST. Thomas University
118605.note: COLlive, 1 Dec 2017: Rabbi Mendy and Tzippy Weiss, Hialeah/Miami Lakes: 'We have been here for 14 years' (so 2003). Their corporation Congregation Tehillat Hashem Inc has an IRS exemption from Nov 2003, which agrees. COLlive, 1 April 2022 (Tzippy Weiss): after years in Cooper City (home bought 1995) they landed 'in Miami Lakes ... and wanted to establish this Chabad house ... For nearly 18 years, that's what it was'.

298937.name: Lubavitch Aventura South
298937.note: CrownHeights.info (from Shmais), 20 June 2005, 'New Shluchim to Aventura Florida': 'Rabbi & Mrs. Mendel Rosenfeld are moving on Shlichus to Aventura, Florida, to expand the existing Aventura Chabad programs ... and to open a strong Chabad presence on the other side of town', appointed by Rabbi Laivi Forta of Aventura Chabad. Miami Herald (CrownHeights.info, 17 Nov 2011): Lubavitch Aventura South had rented two salons at the Aventura Courtyard Marriott; its first place of its own, a temporary sanctuary of five trailers, opened five days before Rosh Hashanah 2011.

earlier.where: rented rooms at the Aventura Courtyard Marriott

1274159.name: Chabad Jewish Center of West Boynton and West Lake Worth
1274159.note: South Florida Sun-Sentinel (COLlive, 23 Sept 2009): 'Rabbi Yosef Raichik of Chabad of West Boynton Beach, a newly operational storefront synagogue just getting off the ground that's a satellite branch of the much larger Chabad of Greater Boynton Beach'. COLlive, 2 June 2013 (Greater Boynton's 18th gala): 'A new satellite Boynton Chabad center has opened, directed by Rabbi & Mrs. Yosef Raichik, in the western part of the city.'
